function.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
function.description: Look up a caller by phone number. ALWAYS call this first when a call connects, using the caller-ID number. Returns {found, customer, open_jobs[], last_call_summary, caller_id_masked}. If found is true, greet by first name and reference their open jobs. If found is false, treat as a new caller. IMPORTANT: if caller_id_masked is true, our line forwarded the call and hid the real number - do NOT guess who they are; ask for their name and a claim or work-order number, then call lookup_by_claim_number.

phone.description: The caller's phone number from caller ID. Any format works - the endpoint normalizes it.
